text.en:
The sum of five hundred thousand pesos is hereby appropriated out of the "Port Works Fund"
created by Act Numbered Three thousand five hundred and ninety-two to be transferred to the General Fund
and used to pay the interests and sinking funds for the year nineteen hundred and thirty-two of the bonds
issued by virtue of Acts Numbered Three thousand four hundred and thirteen and Three thousand four
hundred and seventeen.

This Act shall take effect on January first, nineteen hundred and thirty-two.
Approved, November 13, 1931.
